prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a sideswipe while changing lanes claim. Injury: back strain. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1486; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following report of a sideswipe collision during a lane change on a multi-lane roadway. Insured vehicle contacted the rear quarter panel of the claimant's vehicle. Both drivers reported no visible police presence at scene; exchange of information completed. Initial contact made with the claimant, who reports a back strain following the impact and has not yet sought treatment.

Entry 2: Recorded recorded statement from the insured driver. Insured states they checked mirrors and signaled before moving into the adjacent lane, and did not see the claimant vehicle in the blind spot. Photos of both vehicles received and added to file. Damage appears consistent with a glancing side contact.

Entry 3: Spoke with the claimant by phone. Claimant is not represented by an attorney and says they are managing communications directly. Claimant describes lower back pain and stiffness, with symptoms worse in the morning. Claimant has been advised of the medical payments coverage available under the policy and was given the process for submitting treatment records.

Entry 4: Claimant provided a copy of an urgent care visit note listing a lumbar strain and recommending rest, over-the-counter pain relief, and follow-up with a primary care provider if symptoms persist. Note added to file. Requested authorization to obtain the full treatment record, which the claimant has agreed to provide.

Entry 5: Vehicle inspection scheduled and completed; repair estimate received and under review. Liability assessment leans toward the insured driver based on the lane change and the statement provided. Bodily injury claim remains open pending updated medical status from the claimant. Follow-up call to be placed to the claimant to confirm treatment progress and any additional expenses incurred.
